# `lookup`

lookup

data/lookups/<stem>.lookup.yaml — A REGISTER IS A VIRTUAL TABLE, and this is its descriptor. The operator, 2026-09-29: "it reads like one register is like virtual table. then many rules from the table domain will fit for the register lookup." A relation states its shape in a descriptor, so a register does too, and the fact that became PLURAL when one register began serving many columns is exactly the one that had nowhere to live. Before it, `source_view` was written into EVERY ROW of the CSV — a table carrying its lineage in each record, tolerable at one source and wrong at eight. Written by mac_lookups; READ by mac_descriptors (to attach the pointer to every declared column) and by check_register_membership (to re-measure across all of them). It had no definition here until validate_schema asked, on its first run, why a new structured artifact was routed to nothing.

> **2 keys at this level carry no description in `mac.schema.json`.** The place to fix one is the schema, which is its one home; this page is generated and cannot hold the answer.
